item.title: security: SCKit abuses ScreenConnect to deploy remote access and target technician sessions
item.description:
Microsoft describes SCKit abusing ScreenConnect to deploy unauthorized remote access and target technician sessions. The post outlines the attack chain, mitigations, and Microsoft Defender XDR hunting guidance.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
